Officer's narrative
Officers responded to a side-impact collision at a signalized intersection in Sugar Land, Texas. Driver 1 was traveling
through the intersection on a green signal when Driver 2 entered from a cross steret and struck the driver's side of the
vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front passenger position and was also in the vehicle at the time of impact.
Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and was transported to a local medical facility for
evaluation. Driver 2 stated that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described, and independent witnesses at the scene
gave statements that matched this account. Photographs taken at the scene show damage to the driver's side door
and quarter panel, which is in line with the angle and force of the impact. Officers found no prior damage to the
vehicle in the records or at the scene. Driver 1 is a member of the same household as the registered policyholder and
was identified as an authorized operator under that household. No citations were issued at the scene.
</page>
